notes.title: Update regarding release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43446251/ab0733a9b94eeb9948c9d99a16356e1699c1890b.png[/img]

Hello all, hope is well! I am Ryan the lead developer and Director of our studio working to release Under The Map. I understand there has been little response regarding the situation of the game recently and I would like to apologise for this and will give an explanation to as why below.

At the moment we are in the process of filing litigation against Discord, as a result account access to the platform has been revoked, this has resulted in us being unable to communicate with other people on the platform we use to hire contracts from whom assist in our game and also because of no account access we are unable to post weekly development updates in our server.

As a result of the litigation and access being revoked and no contact with other contracted developers our game has been slightly delayed as we work on filing the correct litigation for Discords negligence that resulted in the wrongful termination and potential data of our account and will chase up loss profits where necessary. 

As you know we were planning on releasing our game around January/February rest assured game progress is still ongoing, I will hopefully be able to have our game released around May/June and will be posting updates on our games progress through steam moving forward until our dispute with Discord is resolved, we have not heard anything back from discords data or legal department in a month so please bare with us as we are trying our best to solve the matter as fast as possible to minimise our games development disruption.

For any questions regarding this matter we will post it on our platforms where relevant and we will not be answering any questions about the matter due to legal reasons but we will be posting answers and updates where it is suitable for our company to do so. We will contact our alpha testers sometime towards the end of this month for information to as when we can expect the round of alpha testing to occur.

Any developer working on our game whom has lost contact with us please contact me via my github email/paypal information.

Kind Regards,
Ryan
Director - NL Studios
